title: ReviewPilotAnalyzePullRequestRequest
description: Internal dispatch contract sent by the Spring Boot backend to the n8n Review Agent workflow.

eventId.description: Unique identifier of the dispatch event.

reviewExecutionId.description: Unique identifier of the review execution created by the backend.

repositoryFullName.description: GitHub repository full name in owner/repository format.

pullRequestNumber.description: Pull Request number within the repository.

expectedHeadSha.description: 40-character Git commit SHA to be analyzed.

baseBranch.description: Target base branch name of the Pull Request.

sonarProjectKey.description: Optional SonarQube project key when static analysis context is configured.
